prompt: Use case: product-mockup. ONE original game controller for Drain Damage, the entire main body and two comfortable stubby hand grips sculpted from SOFT PLUMBER'S PUTTY. Clearly show pale warm gray-beige non-hardening putty, matte slightly oily kneaded material, thumb impressions, subtle fingerprints, rounded hand-smoothed edges, compressed seams and gentle bulging around inserted hardware. Looks soft, pliable and homemade but practical, not stone, ceramic, cheese, bread, foam or slime. Original broad asymmetric rounded cushion-like control deck and two short rounded downward grip lobes, not a recognizable commercial controller model. Hardware embedded neatly in putty: large crisp black raised cross D-pad upper left; four circular colored buttons upper right in a diamond labeled Y top yellow, X left blue, B right red, A bottom green. Two distinct black rubber analog sticks with steel washer collars side by side on lower central deck. Two small black center buttons: left shows two overlapping rectangles (View), right shows three horizontal lines (Menu). Two clearly visible dark rubber shoulder tabs along upper edge. Putty squeezed subtly around metal washers and button bezels, but never covers letters or movement surfaces. Subtle comedy in lovingly thumb-molded construction, all controls large and legible at 315x210 pixels. Front/top nearly orthographic view, entire controller fully visible centered large with generous margins, soft light-gray neutral studio backdrop and subtle shadow. Premium realistic tactile product concept photography, landscape 3:2 1536x1024. No hands, tools, tub, wires, extra objects, logos, branding, words or labels beyond button letters. One mockup, no collage.
